name: Dia
desc: Browser built around an AI chat that reads your open tabs.
desc_zh: 以 AI 对话为核心、可以直接读取你打开的标签页的浏览器。
solves: A dozen tabs open at once, with the answer scattered across all of them. The chat box reads the pages you have open and gives back one integrated answer.
solves_zh: 同时开着十几个标签页，答案散在各处。对话框直接读你打开的页面，给出一段整合过的回答。
best_for: Research has already piled up in tabs and you want AI to read them all at once.
best_for_zh: 研究时已经攒了一堆标签页、想让 AI 一次读完。
notes: The most-copied AI browser design — Arc team's rebuild of the browser around chat rather than a sidebar. 来源：https://baike.baidu.com/item/Dia/65727450
